name: Glaucoma-Sleep Apnea Syndrome
aliases: Glaucoma Associated with Obstructive Sleep Apnea

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Diagnostic Criteria for Glaucoma-Sleep Apnea Syndrome

criteria.description: Confirmed diagnosis of glaucoma based on optic nerve damage and visual field defects
Polysomnographic evidence of obstructive sleep apnea with apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) >15 events/hour
Documented nocturnal intraocular pressure fluctuations or elevated IOP
Signs of optic nerve ischemia or vascular dysregulation

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of confirmed glaucoma and polysomnographic diagnosis of obstructive sleep apnea
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires multidisciplinary evaluation including ophthalmology and sleep medicine

imaging: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) showing retinal nerve fiber layer thinning
Visual field testing demonstrating glaucomatous defects
MRI brain to exclude other optic neuropathies
other: Tonometry indicating elevated or fluctuating intraocular pressure
Fundoscopic examination revealing optic nerve cupping

redFlags: Rapid progression of visual field loss
Sudden onset of optic disc hemorrhage
references: Orphanet Report on Glaucoma-Sleep Apnea Syndrome, ORPHA:2085
Kiely PM, et al. Sleep apnea and glaucoma: a review. J Glaucoma. 2018;27(8):695-701.
Geyer O, et al. The association between obstructive sleep apnea and glaucoma. Surv Ophthalmol. 2015;60(5):503-511.
